scope: Independent production status window after the final monitor lib43 / api lib69 incremental deployments; earlier initial-fix samples are excluded from all interval/counter totals.

deployment.source: Parent agent official deployment result; approximate effective time, not inferred from snapshots.

comparisonMembershipOnly.warning: Membership comparison only. No elapsed or counter delta across the hours between deployments is treated as a single sampling interval.

recoveredFailures.note: Error classification uses the saved error text; it does not establish which HTTP or persistence stage caused a timeout.

findings.interpretation: A real cadence gap, while still below the configured stale threshold; not evidence of permanent starvation.

limitations: Anonymized group numbers are stable only within this report. No owner, user, store, SKU, target key, credentials or token identifiers are emitted.

31 or any later current group count comes from final status. Only keys retained in every final snapshot contribute to the full-window counter/interval totals. Group additions/removals are listed separately.

Recorded interval means use differences in cumulative count/sumMs, representing intervals completed during the final snapshot window. The first completed interval may start before its first snapshot or deployment; strictly post-deployment exact single intervals are separately reported.

A timestamp span with more than one added request/success is not one interval. Exact single intervals require the relevant cumulative counter to increase by exactly one. A 59-second poll need not contain exactly one request.
The inherited lifetime maxMs is not a window maximum; no p95 is reconstructed. Observed exact-single minima/maxima cover only individually recoverable intervals and are not whole-window extrema.

Scheduler request times precede admission/HTTP work. Success times include the upstream outcome transaction. Durable equality validates the corresponding saved success but does not reconstruct all raw HTTP/DB stage timings.
Snapshot counters and timestamps cannot exclude transient same-instant duplicates hidden inside a multi-request segment; exact-phase behavior also requires code regression tests.
Invocation stats reset each scheduled invocation and are displayed only per snapshot, never differenced or summed as cumulative totals.
Freshness is measured against the configured stale threshold; it does not establish an exact 60-second SLA or real WeChat phone receipt. Sender authReady only verifies sender readiness.
